commit 65ca2294619f865362332ceddc622db92d0f50a6
Author: Jay Satiro <raysatiro@yahoo.com>
Date:   Thu Jan 28 18:56:50 2021 -0500

    tool_writeout: refactor write-out and write-out json
    
    - Deduplicate the logic used by write-out and write-out json.
    
    Rather than have separate writeLong, writeString, etc, logic for
    each of write-out and write-out json instead have respective shared
    functions that can output either format and a 'use_json' parameter to
    indicate whether it is json that is output.
    
    This will make it easier to maintain. Rather than have to go through
    two sets of logic now we only have to go through one.
    
    - Support write-out %{errormsg} and %{exitcode} in json.
    
    - Clarify in the doc that %{exitcode} is the exit code of the transfer.
    
====

commit 04c03416e68fd635a15cae8201872f5c29fdcca8
Author: Mathias Gumz <mg@2hoch5.com>
Date:   Sat Feb 1 18:55:24 2020 +0100

    writeout: support to generate JSON output
    
    This commit adds support to generate JSON via the writeout feature:
    
        -w "%{json}"
    
    It leverages the existing infrastructure as much as possible. Thus,
    generating the JSON on STDERR is possible by:
    
        -w "%{stderr}%{json}"
    
    This implements a variant of
    https://github.com/curl/curl/wiki/JSON#--write-out-json.
    
    Closes #4870

## Answer

**Yes** — curl can print transfer stats as JSON with `-w`/`--write-out` using the `%{json}` variable, exactly as you remembered.

### Supporting commit

**SHA:** `04c03416e68fd635a15cae8201872f5c29fdcca8`
(confirmed to be an ancestor of the pinned HEAD `ee521a1c889f4cde6905c5db117959917568be9b`)

**Author/Date:** Mathias Gumz, Sat Feb 1 2020 — `writeout: support to generate JSON output`

**Commit message excerpt** (quotes the exact syntax you were thinking of):

> This commit adds support to generate JSON via the writeout feature:
>
>     -w "%{json}"
>
> It leverages the existing infrastructure as much as possible. Thus, generating the JSON on STDERR is possible by:
>
>     -w "%{stderr}%{json}"
>
> This implements a variant of https://github.com/curl/curl/wiki/JSON#--write-out-json.
>
> Closes #4870

**Documentation diff added by this commit** (`docs/cmdline-opts/write-out.d`):

```diff
 .B http_version
 The http version that was effectively used. (Added in 7.50.0)
 .TP
+.B json
+A JSON object with all available keys.
+.TP
 .B local_ip
```

This commit also added the implementation files `src/tool_writeout_json.c` / `src/tool_writeout_json.h` that render the JSON object.

Later commits in the history refine this feature (e.g. `4133a69f2` adds `%{header_json}`, and `65ca22946` refactors write-out/write-out-json and adds `%{errormsg}`/`%{exitcode}` support in JSON), but the original commit that establishes the `-w "%{json}"` capability is `04c03416e`.
